trigger.description: Tailscale identity flipped between a cached SRR6.46.13 discovery-cache write and the next status lookup (operator logged out of tailnet A and into tailnet B on the same machine, or migrated to a new tailnet). evaluate_discovery_cache returns DiscoveryCacheRefreshReason::TailnetChanged at src/mesh/discovery_cache.rs:192-194, which surfaces the discovery_cache_invalidated_tailnet_changed degraded code so callers know the cached peer set no longer corresponds to the current tailnet identity and a fresh probe will run.
setup_commands: ee mesh enable --workspace . --json   # populates the SRR6.46.13 discovery cache against tailnet-alpha
tailscale up --login-server <other-coordinator>   # or tailscale logout && tailscale up against tailnet-beta
